description: dispatch() handles Command::Group by returning Response::group_selected(&group_str, 0, 0, 0) — hardcoded zeros for count/low/high. lifecycle.rs overrides this with handle_group_live() which returns live data. But run_command_loop only reaches handle_group_live for authenticated (non-Authenticating) sessions. If a bug or future code path ever calls dispatch() for GROUP on an Active/GroupSelected session that does not hit the match arm in lifecycle, clients see stale 0s. The dispatch() GROUP handler should be unreachable or explicitly panic — having a silent 0,0,0 fallback is a correctness trap.
title: GROUP response returns (0,0,0) via dispatch, not live data
